title: Pre-build AC decision is code, not prose
context: Eleven changes shipped without a written promise because the building agent chose the exemption.
decision: A small script applies a fixed ask-or-decide table and a lexical HOW test; the AC text is frozen by hash in the plan stub; an unattended ask stops the unit as escalated/ac_question_requires_operator; the F11 read is advisory.
consequences: Operators get a plain question in four cases; the replay bar for the outcome classes FAILED (5 of 9 non-demand cases flagged) and the campaign stops for the operator.
rationale: Deterministic-first: the table and the HOW test are testable code; the class judgement stays with the operator.
rejected: Prose only (rejected by the brief: deterministic-first); a blocking PR check (outside the campaign)
